scope: Independent QA only; no production edits, build, commit or deployment

baselineSequence.trajectorySampling: Every tenth update; kinematic peaks measured every update

candidateGates.name: frozen freshness and scope
candidateGates.criterion: Source/head, offline/online hashes and all actual resources bind final receipt. Producer does not approve implementation. No source mutation during test.

candidateGates.name: original source fidelity
candidateGates.criterion: Independent binary decode and actual GPU readback preserve complete source positions, normals, UVs, triangle tuples and original encoded image pixels. Original R14 carrier remains byte-identical. No removal, downsampling or invented anatomy.

candidateGates.name: finite independent collective state
candidateGates.criterion: Six sources, 30 independent actors, all vectors/quaternions and solver clocks finite. Pause and zero delta leave state unchanged. No permanent invisible individual leader or target-slot pose lock. Different actor states remain present.

candidateGates.name: bounded continuity
candidateGates.criterion: Measure velocity, yaw/pitch/roll rate, acceleration and actual position corrections. Candidate must obey its declared per-species limits with numerical tolerance, or clearly documented initial-contact handling isolated from live updates. Inspect actual display poses for fixed-step interpolation artifacts. Compare p95 and maxima to R07; no improvement claim based solely on output smoothing hiding solver teleports.

candidateGates.name: source-aware contact
candidateGates.criterion: Measured full source envelope, source variant scale and actual frame orientation determine SAT clearance. No sustained overlap worse than -1e-5 body lengths after initialization; specific extremely narrow transient tolerance requires source-scale diagnosis rather than gate reduction. Mesh envelope is conservative and must be labelled as such, not mesh-exact collision.

candidateGates.name: cohesion, response and recovery
candidateGates.criterion: Report nearest distance distribution, perception degrees, largest connected component, polarization, group radius and pointer excitation. All fish must stay finite and remain represented. Coordinated turn/burst must reach distinct actual collective states; pointer produces bounded response and excitation decays after removal. Separation/contact safety must not be traded for graph connectivity. Biological calibration remains unverified.

candidateGates.name: delta and long trajectory
candidateGates.criterion: Fixed 30/60/120Hz and bounded variable frame deltas run same accepted-time schedule. Assert preserved accumulated simulation time, finite state and bounded step/heading/contact values, without requiring exact new-school poses to match R07. Longer trajectory remains stable without school collapse or stationary all-fish locking.

candidateGates.name: behavior cost and frame time
candidateGates.criterion: Same-realm CPU baseline/current update costs separately measured from graph/contact analysis. Same hardware, full body geometry, 30 actors and same controlled browser sequence measure update/upload/render dispatch, draw calls, triangles and RAF median/p95. Preserve R07 eye batching and full draw budget; no lower source detail as shortcut. Any sustained frame regression needs a diagnosed root cause before promotion.

candidateGates.name: R07 memory and startup invariants
candidateGates.criterion: Only active decoded source cached; hidden legacy iframe unmounted/context released; returning source works. Same GC page heap and explicit GL accounting. Slow streaming shell/catalog/progress, integrity failure/retry/cancel, desktop/mobile and offline zero core HTTP retained. JS heap is not total process/GPU memory.

candidateGates.name: actual visual sequence
candidateGates.criterion: Actual GPU browser evidence for all six schools through cruise/turn/burst/rest/pointer/recovery and pause. Review new temporal motion, original source surface continuity, bounded source eyes and two supported tuna mouths. New collective poses are intentionally not forced to pixel-match old poses. User visualAcceptance and productionReady remain false.

releaseRestriction: Automatic approval currently rejects Pages writes. Verifier performs no publish or workaround. Parent must resolve approval before external deployment.
